title.narrative: Promoting Inclusive Teaching and Education in Emergencies (EiE) through Teacher Education for Crisis-Affected Areas

description.narrative: The project aims to advance inclusive teaching and Education in Emergencies (EiE) strategies through teacher education, aligning with UNESCO's 42 C/5 Output by enhancing equitable and quality education in crisis-affected areas. Key activities include training 40-50 educators, developing inclusive teaching methods, and integrating EiE strategies into education frameworks. The project targets 80% of trained educators applying inclusive methods by its end, with baselines set by assessing current educator preparedness. Direct beneficiaries include educators, policymakers, and community leaders, with key partners such as national training institutions, government education departments, NGOs, and technology providers. The long-term impact includes improved education quality during emergencies, increased access for vulnerable populations, and strengthened education systems, contributing to SDG 4 and the 2030 Asia-Pacific Education Framework.
